_note: Prototype org-context file. The org (Northwind Logistics) is fictional demo data. The pillars and systems are the LeadOS leadership operating stack: five tiers, ten systems (S0-S9), each tier enabling the next. unlockWeek is the programme week a system switches on (default week 1).

values.name: Own it end to end
values.meaning: We follow work through to the customer outcome, not just our part of it.

values.name: Say the hard thing kindly
values.meaning: We raise problems early and directly, with care for the person.

values.name: Customers feel the difference
values.meaning: Decisions are judged by what changes for the customer.

managerStandards: Every direct report has a 1:1 at least every two weeks, and it is rarely cancelled.
Feedback is given within 48 hours of the moment it relates to.
Performance concerns are raised early, stated with specific examples, and shared with your HR business partner before any formal step.
Team meetings end with clear owners and dates for every action.
Each quarter, every team member can say what the team's top three priorities are.

pillars.name: Lead Yourself
pillars.summary: Manage your own energy and make good decisions before you lead anyone else.

pillars.name: Set the Standard
pillars.summary: The team knows what good looks like and what matters most.

pillars.name: Develop People
pillars.summary: Each person hears what they need to and grows through regular 1:1s.

pillars.name: Hold the Standard
pillars.summary: Feedback is timely and gaps in performance are dealt with early and fairly.

pillars.name: Grow & Sustain
pillars.summary: The team keeps getting better and the manager keeps learning.
